note: Only publicly watchable work with a verified creator and original source is included. Null shot counts and empty prompt lists mean the creator did not publish those details.

pieces.title: Air Head
pieces.synopsis: A man with a yellow balloon for a head reflects on the strange practicalities and possibilities of his life.

workflow_steps: Write a short script and define the story beats before generating.
Generate a large pool of Sora clips from many goal-specific prompts.
Edit the material like documentary footage, selecting moments that serve the scripted beats.
Use conventional VFX, rotoscoping, sound design, colour correction, and editorial timing to finish the film.

prompts.text: Man with a yellow balloon for a head. 35mm film.

pieces.title: The Hardest Part
pieces.synopsis: An unbroken dreamlike journey moves through a couple’s imagined life, memory, loss, and the impossibility of going back.

workflow_steps: Return to a decade-old concept built around an impossible continuous zoom through a couple’s life.
Write detailed Sora prompts that specify imagery, shot angle, movement, and spatial transitions.
Generate short scenes and select transitions that can carry the forward zoom.
Direct and edit the generated scenes into one continuous memory journey set to the finished Washed Out track.

prompts.text: We zoom through the bubble it pops and we zoom through the bubblegum and enter an open football field.
